subject: Okta SSO certificate renewal failure
resolution_summary: Rotated IdP X.509 certificate in Okta Admin Console and updated CloudDesk SSO SAML metadata URL.
troubleshooting_steps: 1. Verify IdP metadata XML expiration timestamp.
2. Upload renewed signing certificate to Identity Provider configuration.
customer_reply: We updated the IdP signing certificate metadata and all enterprise members can now sign in via SSO.

subject: Mid-cycle seat reduction refund
resolution_summary: Calculated prorated credit for 2 downgraded seats and credited back to customer account balance.
troubleshooting_steps: 1. Calculate seat differential against billing period duration.
2. Create approval request for credit issuance.
3. Apply credit to account billing invoice.
customer_reply: We have credited your invoice for the unused seats. Your updated invoice balance is now reflected in your billing portal.

subject: Sync script encountering 429 Too Many Requests
resolution_summary: Added exponential backoff with jitter and increased request batch size to reduce call frequency.
troubleshooting_steps: 2. Implement exponential backoff in sync worker script.
3. Consolidate individual item queries into batch endpoints.
customer_reply: The API rate limit is 120 requests/minute. We recommend adding backoff handling to your sync client as detailed in our API docs.

subject: Workspace file uploads blocked at quota threshold
resolution_summary: Purged soft-deleted files from trash and upgraded storage tier.
troubleshooting_steps: 2. Empty workspace trash to reclaim unpurged deleted bytes.
3. Upgrade quota tier if additional capacity is required.
customer_reply: Emptying your workspace trash bin reclaimed 1.5 GB of storage space, restoring upload capabilities.

subject: External collaborator invite button grayed out
resolution_summary: Enabled external collaboration policy in Workspace Settings under Security & Sharing.
troubleshooting_steps: 2. Toggle 'Allow external link sharing' to enabled.
3. Save changes and retry inviting external collaborator.
customer_reply: Your workspace administrator has enabled external sharing permissions for your team workspace.
